profit_without_cash.title: Profit without cash
profit_without_cash.rule: Net profit up at least 10% while operating cash flow fell at least 10% in the latest year; or 3-year operating cash flow / EBIT below 0.6 and in the bottom 10% of peers.
profit_without_cash.signals: Earnings are not turning into cash.
profit_without_cash.innocent: Fast growth ties up working capital; large one-off tax or pension payments; timing of customer prepayments.

high_accruals.title: High accruals
high_accruals.rule: (Net profit - operating cash flow) / average total assets in the top 10% of peers and above 5%.
high_accruals.signals: Earnings quality (Sloan, 1996): a large share of profit comes from accruals rather than cash.
high_accruals.innocent: Non-cash gains (asset sales, revaluations), growth investment in working capital.

receivables_outpace_sales.title: Receivables outpace sales
receivables_outpace_sales.rule: Trade receivables grew at least 20 percentage points faster than revenue, with receivables at least 5% of revenue.
receivables_outpace_sales.signals: Aggressive revenue recognition, or customers paying more slowly.
receivables_outpace_sales.innocent: A large order invoiced near year-end, acquisitions at year-end, a change in factoring.

inventory_build_up.title: Inventory build-up
inventory_build_up.rule: Inventories grew at least 20 percentage points faster than revenue, with inventories at least 5% of revenue.
inventory_build_up.innocent: Stocking up ahead of launches or expected price rises, supply-chain buffers, acquisitions.

heavy_capitalisation.title: Heavy capitalisation
heavy_capitalisation.rule: Spending on intangible assets (incl. capitalised development) at least 5% of revenue, in the top 10% of peers, and higher than two years earlier.
heavy_capitalisation.signals: Costs moved from the income statement to the balance sheet.
heavy_capitalisation.innocent: Software and R&D-heavy business models capitalise development under IAS 38 by design.

acquisition_driven.title: Acquisition-driven
acquisition_driven.rule: Goodwill / equity at least 0.8 and up at least 0.1 over two years.
acquisition_driven.signals: Growth bought rather than built; impairment risk.
acquisition_driven.innocent: Serial acquirers with a disciplined model; goodwill is tested for impairment yearly.

leverage_creep.title: Leverage creep
leverage_creep.rule: Net debt / EBITDA at least 2.5x and up at least 1.0x over two years, while cash conversion fell.
leverage_creep.innocent: Debt-funded acquisitions that have not yet contributed a full year of EBITDA.
